# Pablo Pavon: AI process automation for small teams; business analyst, Berlin

> Pablo Pavon is a freelance business analyst based in Berlin, Germany, originally from Argentina. He works remotely with small and mid-sized companies and teams in Argentina, Latin America, Israel and Europe, in Spanish, English and German. He specialises in reviewing how teams work and moving the repetitive part to AI with controls: one place for the team's AI work, automations that report their own failures, and finance processes that run themselves. He designed and built SearchedBy, an AI product live in production, now part of NexYn. He has ten years of experience across banking, e-commerce, marketing analytics and insurance.

Facts: based in Berlin, Germany (CET); from Argentina; languages: Spanish (native), English (C1), German (B2);
fully remote; engagement models: process review, setup at a fixed price, monthly follow-up; replies within 1–2 business days.
The case studies on the site use synthetic data from fictional companies, and the code is public on GitHub. The exceptions are SearchedBy (formerly GEO Scan), an AI product Pablo designed and built, now part of NexYn, live at https://searchedby.com/ (private code, public case study), and the pilot case on the AI process review page, a real engagement described without the client's name.
Site last updated: 2026-11-19.

## Services
- AI process review / Revisión de procesos con IA: An inventory of your recurring work, written by your own AI from a task I send; a review area by area; up to seven decisions, each with a recommended option.
- One place for your AI work / Tu IA, en un solo lugar: Chats, projects and scheduled tasks moved into one Claude Code project: clear rules, a folder per area, nightly backups, sending and deleting blocked by default.
- Automations with controls / Automatizaciones con controles: Recurring reports, field notes sorted the same day, reminders to the team as drafts, a check on every draft before it goes out. Each one says whether it ran and alerts you when it fails.
- Finance processes that run themselves / Procesos de finanzas que corren solos: Bank reconciliation, supplier invoice control, collections and cash forecasting that update themselves every morning, for SMEs and accounting firms.
- Requirements and process maps / Requerimientos y mapas de procesos: Discovery, user stories with acceptance criteria, functional specs and process maps that IT can build without guessing, and a manual your team can follow.
- Your team and AI / Tu equipo y la IA: A short, practical course by role, built on your team's real tasks, and a map of who already uses AI and how.

## Case studies (English)
- [SearchedBy: an AI product](https://pablodpavon.com/proyectos/geo-scan.html): SearchedBy (formerly GEO Scan), an AI product I designed and built, now part of NexYn: it shows how visible a business is in AI search. Built with Claude Code, checked by 7,700+ tests. Code: https://github.com/pablodpavon/geo-scan-case-study
- [How I ship AI systems](https://pablodpavon.com/proyectos/ai-systems-operating-model.html): How I build and run SearchedBy with Claude Code: numbered decisions, tests first, md5-verified deploys, blind evaluation sets and native language review. Code: https://github.com/pablodpavon/searchedby-engineering
- [From workshop to backlog, traceable](https://pablodpavon.com/proyectos/requirements-to-backlog.html): an LLM drafts epics and user stories from a workshop transcript, and code checks that every story quotes what someone actually said. Code: https://github.com/pablodpavon/requirements-to-backlog
- [Automated daily reconciliation and cash](https://pablodpavon.com/proyectos/conciliacion-y-caja.html): bank reconciliation, collections and a 20-day cash forecast that run by themselves every morning. Code: https://github.com/pablodpavon/daily-cash-control
- [Accounts payable control](https://pablodpavon.com/proyectos/cuentas-a-pagar.html): 12 rules over 1,260 supplier invoices, CUIT validation and 3-way match before the payment run. Code: https://github.com/pablodpavon/ap-invoice-control
- [Data migration with reconciliation](https://pablodpavon.com/proyectos/migracion-de-datos.html): spec-driven migration of 4,060 customers and 6,500 contracts with 12 reconciliation checks. Code: https://github.com/pablodpavon/data-migration-toolkit
- [AI KPI report, verified](https://pablodpavon.com/proyectos/reporte-con-ia.html): an LLM drafts the monthly KPI commentary and a checker verifies every number before release. Code: https://github.com/pablodpavon/ai-kpi-commentary

## Casos de estudio (español)
- [SearchedBy: producto con IA](https://pablodpavon.com/es/proyectos/geo-scan.html): SearchedBy (antes GEO Scan), producto con IA que diseñé y construí, hoy de NexYn: muestra cuán visible es un negocio en las búsquedas con IA. Hecho con Claude Code y controlado con 7.700+ tests.
- [Cómo llevo sistemas con IA a producción](https://pablodpavon.com/es/proyectos/ai-systems-operating-model.html): Cómo construyo y opero SearchedBy con Claude Code: decisiones numeradas, tests primero, deploys verificados por md5, sets ciegos y revisión nativa por idioma.
- [Del workshop al backlog, con trazabilidad](https://pablodpavon.com/es/proyectos/requirements-to-backlog.html): un modelo de lenguaje arma épicas y user stories desde la transcripción de un workshop, y un control en código verifica que cada story cite algo que alguien dijo.
- [Conciliación y caja diaria automáticas](https://pablodpavon.com/es/proyectos/conciliacion-y-caja.html): conciliación bancaria, cobranzas y proyección de caja a 20 días que corren solas cada mañana para una pyme.
- [Control de cuentas a pagar](https://pablodpavon.com/es/proyectos/cuentas-a-pagar.html): 12 reglas sobre 1.260 facturas de proveedores, validación de CUIT y cruce con orden de compra y recepción antes de pagar.
- [Migración de datos con conciliación](https://pablodpavon.com/es/proyectos/migracion-de-datos.html): migración guiada por una especificación de mapeo, 4.060 clientes y 6.500 contratos, con 12 controles de conciliación.
- [Reporte de KPIs con IA verificado](https://pablodpavon.com/es/proyectos/reporte-con-ia.html): un modelo de lenguaje redacta el comentario mensual de KPIs y un control verifica cada número antes de publicarlo.

## Product
- SearchedBy: https://searchedby.com/: shows a business how AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google's AI) present it, and whether its site can be read, cited and recommended. Designed and built by Pablo Pavon; today a NexYn product; formerly called GEO Scan. About: https://searchedby.com/about/
